description: This is a test class for the EmployeePictureService in the OrangeHRM project, specifically testing the EmployeePictureService's methods related to employee picture retrieval, saving, and size adjustment within the PIM module.

classes.name: EmployeePictureServiceTest
classes.description: This class contains unit tests for the EmployeePictureService, covering methods for obtaining employee pictures, saving pictures, size adjustments, and generating ETags based on picture content.

methods.name: testGetEmployeePictureDao
methods.description: Verifies that the EmployeePictureService returns an instance of EmployeePictureDao.

methods.name: testGetAccessibleEmpPictureByEmpNumber
methods.description: Tests retrieving an accessible employee picture when the user has permissions.

methods.name: testGetAccessibleEmpPictureByEmpNumberNotAllowed
methods.description: Ensures the method returns null when the user does not have access to the employee picture.

methods.name: testGetEmpPictureByEmpNumber
methods.description: Tests retrieving an employee picture by employee number.

methods.name: testSaveEmployeePicture
methods.description: Tests saving an employee picture and expects the saved picture to be returned.

methods.name: testPictureSizeAdjust
methods.description: Tests the image size adjustment logic with various images.

methods.name: getPictureSizeAdjustDataProvider
methods.description: Provides fixture data for various image size test cases.

methods.name: testGetETagByEmpPicture
methods.description: Tests generating an ETag for an employee picture based on its content.
